items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I can't call their name because I know that little guitar player used to stay like Desvin. I used to know him.

ctx.x: Well, I just did. I want to tell you, he used to come around with Louis and Joe and them. I know plenty of musicians and, uh, I can't call their name because I know that little guitar player used to stay like Desvin. I used to know him. I just forgot about them. He was a good cornet, uh, cornet player, Desvin. Yeah, he kind of was new, him.
Yeah, I knew they'd been there, but they used to be one of the, one of the men of the, of French singing they had. Nothing but nice singing they had, French.
